card.name: Words just before a bare verb
card.fires_on: Small words such as "to", "I", "'ve", "they", "not" or "always" that sit right before an expected plain verb like see, find, catch, leave or obtain. Seen in general web prose.

modes.label: "to" before a verb
modes.description: The word "to" after hard, chance or be, where a verb like see, obtain, catch or quit comes next.

modes.label: Subject or auxiliary before a verb
modes.description: A pronoun or contraction such as I, they or 've that is followed by a verb like leave or found.
modes.example: places to go before<< I>> leave this mortal coil.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are physical action verbs (bite, dig, grab, kick, knock), so it pushes toward a verb next, with no clear single meaning.
card.plain: It fires on little words like "to" or "I" when the next word should be an action verb.
